obligations.title: Finite Stieltjes-measure integrability on the interval
obligations.source_ref: Theorem 7.8 finite-interval setup: continuous g on [a,b] is measurable/bounded and integrable with respect to F.measure on Icc a b.
obligations.notes: Materialized from diagnoser obligation T7.8.integrability. The proof must not use lsIntegral_eq_rsIntegral_stieltjesFunction or rs_stieltjes_ch7_bridge_debt.
obligations.expected_theorem_signature: From ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b), prove IntegrableOn g (Set.Icc a b) F.measure for a StieltjesFunction F.
obligations.proof_contract_notes: The theorem proves integrability from ContinuousOn on compact Icc via hg.integrableOn_compact; it does not assume integrability or a bridge equality.

obligations.title: Construct the Riemann-Stieltjes integral using Theorem 1.1 support
obligations.source_ref: Theorem 7.8 source route: continuous g on [a,b] is Riemann-Stieltjes integrable with respect to the nondecreasing Stieltjes function F.
obligations.notes: Check the current thm_1_1 family signatures and local RSIntegrable API before implementation. The proof must use the strict a < b route and must not wrap lsIntegral_eq_rsIntegral_stieltjesFunction.
obligations.expected_theorem_signature: (F : StieltjesFunction R) {a b : R} {g : R -> R} (hab : a < b) (hg : ContinuousOn g (Icc a b)) : RSIntegrable g F a b
obligations.proof_contract_notes: The proof extends g from Icc a b, applies thm_1_1 on a strict interval, and transfers by rsIntegrable_congr_integrand_Icc. It does not assume RSIntegrable g F a b.

obligations.title: Lower and upper simple-function sandwich
obligations.source_ref: Theorem 7.8 source proof: compare lower and upper Stieltjes sums with Lebesgue-Stieltjes simple functions over {a} and half-open cells.
obligations.notes: The F.measure {a} = 0 hypothesis must be localized to the left-endpoint contribution.
obligations.expected_theorem_signature: For every DarbouxRS.Partition P, use lower/upper source simple functions over {a} and half-open cells plus hAtom : F.measure {a} = 0 to derive lowerSum P g F <= LS interval integral <= upperSum P g F.
obligations.proof_contract_notes: The left endpoint is handled internally through hAtom and a.e. equality; the Darboux-sum sandwich is derived by integral monotonicity and cell-step integral identities.

obligations.title: Common-limit squeeze from Stieltjes sums
obligations.source_ref: Theorem 7.8 source proof: lower and upper Stieltjes sums have the RS common limit and squeeze the Lebesgue-Stieltjes integral to the same value.
obligations.notes: This is the final finite-interval equality step before parent reassembly.
obligations.expected_theorem_signature: Given hRS : RSIntegrable g F a b and a lower/upper Darboux squeeze for every partition, prove the LS interval integral equals rsIntegral g F a b hRS.
obligations.proof_contract_notes: The helper uses rsIntegral_source_spec hRS and a common-limit squeeze. It does not call lsIntegral_eq_rsIntegral_stieltjesFunction.

obligations.title: Downstream truncation instantiation support
obligations.source_ref: Theorem 7.8 must be usable by later Chapter 7 truncation arguments, especially Theorem 7.9, without adding hidden endpoint assumptions.
obligations.notes: This prevents landing a finite-interval bridge that cannot be instantiated for later truncations.
obligations.expected_theorem_signature: Given hgInt, hRS, and hSqueeze, package IntegrableOn plus an RSIntegrable witness and interval integral equality for downstream use.
obligations.proof_contract_notes: The theorem packages exactly prior child outputs and constructs the equality witness through thm_7_8_common_limit_squeeze_rsIntegral. It does not assume the final equality or use a bridge-debt declaration.
